collection.description: Former spouses discuss how to remain part of one another's community.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (spouse1) and (spouse2), former spouses, discuss how to remain part of one another's community.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They enjoy a relaxed shared gathering.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They discover they need firmer boundaries first.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The distance helps both find peace.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Mutual friends feel unsure how to include them.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A difficult conversation requires another meeting.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Both feel free to move forward.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: One needs longer to adjust and is given space.
